question: Which customer segments have an average order payment value above 209?
query:
SELECT cs.name_customer_segments, AVG(p.amount) AS avg_order_value
FROM customer_segments cs
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_segment_id = cs.id
JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id
JOIN payments p ON p.order_id = o.id
GROUP BY cs.id, cs.name_customer_segments
HAVING AVG(p.amount) > 209
ORDER BY avg_order_value DESC;

ORDER BY discounted_pct DESC;

question: Which customers have ordered products from at least 3 different product categories?

JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id

JOIN product_categories pc ON p.product_category_id = pc.id
GROUP BY c.id, c.name_customers
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT pc.id) >= 3
ORDER BY category_count DESC;

question: Which products cost more than the average unit price within their own category?
query:
SELECT p.name_products, p.unit_price, pc.name_product_categories
FROM products p
JOIN product_categories pc ON p.product_category_id = pc.id
WHERE p.unit_price > (
    SELECT AVG(p2.unit_price) FROM products p2
    WHERE p2.product_category_id = p.product_category_id
)
ORDER BY pc.name_product_categories, p.unit_price DESC;

FROM products p

ORDER BY p.stock_quantity ASC;

question: Find products discounted on more than 40% of their order items.
query:
SELECT p.name_products,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN oi.discount > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS discounted_pct
FROM order_items oi
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id
GROUP BY p.id, p.name_products
HAVING 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN oi.discount > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) > 40
ORDER BY discounted_pct DESC;

question: Find products discounted on more than 59% of their order items.
query:
SELECT p.name_products,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN oi.discount > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS discounted_pct
FROM order_items oi
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id
GROUP BY p.id, p.name_products
HAVING 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN oi.discount > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) > 59
ORDER BY discounted_pct DESC;

question: Find sales employees with more than 13 orders in 2023, along with the total payments they generated.
query:
SELECT e.name_employees, COUNT(o.id) AS order_count, SUM(p.amount) AS total_payment_volume
FROM employees e
JOIN orders o ON o.employee_id = e.id
LEFT JOIN payments p ON p.order_id = o.id
WHERE e.role_employees = 'sales'
  AND o.order_date >= '2023-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2024-01-01'
GROUP BY e.id, e.name_employees
HAVING COUNT(o.id) > 13
ORDER BY total_payment_volume DESC;

question: Which customer segments have an average order payment value above 65?
query:
SELECT cs.name_customer_segments, AVG(p.amount) AS avg_order_value
FROM customer_segments cs
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_segment_id = cs.id
JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id
JOIN payments p ON p.order_id = o.id
GROUP BY cs.id, cs.name_customer_segments
HAVING AVG(p.amount) > 65
ORDER BY avg_order_value DESC;

question: Find products discounted on more than 49% of their order items.
query:
SELECT p.name_products,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN oi.discount > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS discounted_pct
FROM order_items oi
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id
GROUP BY p.id, p.name_products
HAVING 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN oi.discount > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) > 49
ORDER BY discounted_pct DESC;

question: Which sales employees handled more than 20 orders in 2025, and what was the total payment volume they managed?
query:
SELECT e.name_employees, COUNT(o.id) AS order_count, SUM(p.amount) AS total_payment_volume
FROM employees e
JOIN orders o ON o.employee_id = e.id
LEFT JOIN payments p ON p.order_id = o.id
WHERE e.role_employees = 'sales'
  AND o.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY e.id, e.name_employees
HAVING COUNT(o.id) > 20
ORDER BY total_payment_volume DESC;

question: Which products had a discount applied in more than 19 percent of their order line items?
query:
SELECT p.name_products,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN oi.discount > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS discounted_pct
FROM order_items oi
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id
GROUP BY p.id, p.name_products
HAVING 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN oi.discount > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) > 19
ORDER BY discounted_pct DESC;

question: Find products priced above their category's average unit price.
query:
SELECT p.name_products, p.unit_price, pc.name_product_categories
FROM products p
JOIN product_categories pc ON p.product_category_id = pc.id
WHERE p.unit_price > (
    SELECT AVG(p2.unit_price) FROM products p2
    WHERE p2.product_category_id = p.product_category_id
)
ORDER BY pc.name_product_categories, p.unit_price DESC;

question: What was the total revenue from the 'Electronics' category in 2018?
query:
SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) AS revenue
FROM order_items oi
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id
JOIN product_categories pc ON p.product_category_id = pc.id
JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.id
WHERE pc.name_product_categories = 'Electronics'
  AND o.order_date >= '2018-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2019-01-01';

question: List the 12 highest-spending customers with their region and customer segment.
query:
SELECT c.name_customers, r.name_regions, cs.name_customer_segments,
       SUM(p.amount) AS total_spent
FROM customers c
JOIN regions r ON c.region_id = r.id
JOIN customer_segments cs ON c.customer_segment_id = cs.id
JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id
JOIN payments p ON p.order_id = o.id
GROUP BY c.id, c.name_customers, r.name_regions, cs.name_customer_segments
ORDER BY total_spent DESC
LIMIT 12;

question: Find product categories whose total order revenue exceeds 172000.
query:
SELECT pc.name_product_categories, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) AS revenue
FROM product_categories pc
JOIN products p ON p.product_category_id = pc.id
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.product_id = p.id
GROUP BY pc.id, pc.name_product_categories
HAVING SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) > 172000
ORDER BY revenue DESC;

FROM order_items oi
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id
GROUP BY p.id, p.name_products
HAVING 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN oi.discount > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) > 44
ORDER BY discounted_pct DESC;

GROUP BY e.id, e.name_employees

ORDER BY total_payment_volume DESC;

question: Which customer segments have an average order payment value above 71?
query:
SELECT cs.name_customer_segments, AVG(p.amount) AS avg_order_value
FROM customer_segments cs
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_segment_id = cs.id
JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id
JOIN payments p ON p.order_id = o.id
GROUP BY cs.id, cs.name_customer_segments
HAVING AVG(p.amount) > 71
ORDER BY avg_order_value DESC;

question: Find product categories whose total order revenue exceeds 155500.
query:
SELECT pc.name_product_categories, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) AS revenue
FROM product_categories pc
JOIN products p ON p.product_category_id = pc.id
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.product_id = p.id
GROUP BY pc.id, pc.name_product_categories
HAVING SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) > 155500
ORDER BY revenue DESC;

question: Which products had a discount applied in more than 53 percent of their order line items?
query:
SELECT p.name_products,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN oi.discount > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS discounted_pct
FROM order_items oi
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id
GROUP BY p.id, p.name_products
HAVING 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN oi.discount > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) > 53
ORDER BY discounted_pct DESC;

FROM orders
GROUP BY channel
ORDER BY cancel_rate_pct DESC;

question: Who are the top 19 customers by total payment amount, including their region and segment?
query:
SELECT c.name_customers, r.name_regions, cs.name_customer_segments,
       SUM(p.amount) AS total_spent
FROM customers c
JOIN regions r ON c.region_id = r.id
JOIN customer_segments cs ON c.customer_segment_id = cs.id
JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id
JOIN payments p ON p.order_id = o.id
GROUP BY c.id, c.name_customers, r.name_regions, cs.name_customer_segments
ORDER BY total_spent DESC
LIMIT 19;

question: Find customer segments whose average payment per order exceeds 112.
query:
SELECT cs.name_customer_segments, AVG(p.amount) AS avg_order_value
FROM customer_segments cs
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_segment_id = cs.id
JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id
JOIN payments p ON p.order_id = o.id
GROUP BY cs.id, cs.name_customer_segments
HAVING AVG(p.amount) > 112
ORDER BY avg_order_value DESC;

question: How much revenue did 'Peripherals' products generate during 2025?
query:
SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) AS revenue
FROM order_items oi
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id
JOIN product_categories pc ON p.product_category_id = pc.id
JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.id
WHERE pc.name_product_categories = 'Peripherals'
  AND o.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-01-01';

GROUP BY c.id, c.name_customers
ORDER BY total_spent DESC
LIMIT 13;

question: Find products discounted on more than 53% of their order items.
query:
SELECT p.name_products,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN oi.discount > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS discounted_pct
FROM order_items oi
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id
GROUP BY p.id, p.name_products
HAVING 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN oi.discount > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) > 53
ORDER BY discounted_pct DESC;

question: Who are the top 8 customers by total payment amount, including their region and segment?
query:
SELECT c.name_customers, r.name_regions, cs.name_customer_segments,
       SUM(p.amount) AS total_spent
FROM customers c
JOIN regions r ON c.region_id = r.id
JOIN customer_segments cs ON c.customer_segment_id = cs.id
JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id
JOIN payments p ON p.order_id = o.id
GROUP BY c.id, c.name_customers, r.name_regions, cs.name_customer_segments
ORDER BY total_spent DESC
LIMIT 8;

question: Which product categories generated more than 63000 in total order revenue?
query:
SELECT pc.name_product_categories, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) AS revenue
FROM product_categories pc
JOIN products p ON p.product_category_id = pc.id
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.product_id = p.id
GROUP BY pc.id, pc.name_product_categories
HAVING SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) > 63000
ORDER BY revenue DESC;

question: Which products had a discount applied in more than 58 percent of their order line items?
query:
SELECT p.name_products,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN oi.discount > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS discounted_pct
FROM order_items oi
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id
GROUP BY p.id, p.name_products
HAVING 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN oi.discount > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) > 58
ORDER BY discounted_pct DESC;

question: What was the total revenue from the 'OS' category in 2017?
query:
SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) AS revenue
FROM order_items oi
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id
JOIN product_categories pc ON p.product_category_id = pc.id
JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.id
WHERE pc.name_product_categories = 'OS'
  AND o.order_date >= '2017-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2018-01-01';

question: Which sales employees handled more than 8 orders in 2019, and what was the total payment volume they managed?
query:
SELECT e.name_employees, COUNT(o.id) AS order_count, SUM(p.amount) AS total_payment_volume
FROM employees e
JOIN orders o ON o.employee_id = e.id
LEFT JOIN payments p ON p.order_id = o.id
WHERE e.role_employees = 'sales'
  AND o.order_date >= '2019-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2020-01-01'
GROUP BY e.id, e.name_employees
HAVING COUNT(o.id) > 8
ORDER BY total_payment_volume DESC;

       ROUND(100.0 * (unit_price - unit_cost) / unit_price, 2) AS margin_pct

question: Which customer segments have an average order payment value above 337?
query:
SELECT cs.name_customer_segments, AVG(p.amount) AS avg_order_value
FROM customer_segments cs
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_segment_id = cs.id
JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id
JOIN payments p ON p.order_id = o.id
GROUP BY cs.id, cs.name_customer_segments
HAVING AVG(p.amount) > 337
ORDER BY avg_order_value DESC;

question: Find sales employees with more than 10 orders in 2019, along with the total payments they generated.
query:
SELECT e.name_employees, COUNT(o.id) AS order_count, SUM(p.amount) AS total_payment_volume
FROM employees e
JOIN orders o ON o.employee_id = e.id
LEFT JOIN payments p ON p.order_id = o.id
WHERE e.role_employees = 'sales'
  AND o.order_date >= '2019-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2020-01-01'
GROUP BY e.id, e.name_employees
HAVING COUNT(o.id) > 10
ORDER BY total_payment_volume DESC;

question: List the 4 biggest spenders in the 'Retail' customer segment.
query:
SELECT c.name_customers, SUM(p.amount) AS total_spent
FROM customers c
JOIN customer_segments cs ON c.customer_segment_id = cs.id
JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id
JOIN payments p ON p.order_id = o.id
WHERE cs.name_customer_segments = 'Retail'
GROUP BY c.id, c.name_customers
ORDER BY total_spent DESC
LIMIT 4;

Question: List the 5 highest-spending customers with their region and customer segment.

SELECT c.name_customers, r.name_regions, cs.name_customer_segments,
       SUM(p.amount) AS total_spent
FROM customers c
JOIN regions r ON c.region_id = r.id
JOIN customer_segments cs ON c.customer_segment_id = cs.id
JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id
JOIN payments p ON p.order_id = o.id
GROUP BY c.id, c.name_customers, r.name_regions, cs.name_customer_segments
ORDER BY total_spent DESC
LIMIT 5;

question: Which product categories generated more than 171500 in total order revenue?
query:
SELECT pc.name_product_categories, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) AS revenue
FROM product_categories pc
JOIN products p ON p.product_category_id = pc.id
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.product_id = p.id
GROUP BY pc.id, pc.name_product_categories
HAVING SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) > 171500
ORDER BY revenue DESC;

question: Who are the top 3 customers by total payment amount, including their region and segment?
query:
SELECT c.name_customers, r.name_regions, cs.name_customer_segments,
       SUM(p.amount) AS total_spent
FROM customers c
JOIN regions r ON c.region_id = r.id
JOIN customer_segments cs ON c.customer_segment_id = cs.id
JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id
JOIN payments p ON p.order_id = o.id
GROUP BY c.id, c.name_customers, r.name_regions, cs.name_customer_segments
ORDER BY total_spent DESC
LIMIT 3;

question: Which region generated the highest revenue from 'Hardware' products?
query:
SELECT r.name_regions, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) AS revenue
FROM order_items oi
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id
JOIN product_categories pc ON p.product_category_id = pc.id
JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.id
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.id
JOIN regions r ON c.region_id = r.id
WHERE pc.name_product_categories = 'Hardware'
GROUP BY r.id, r.name_regions
ORDER BY revenue DESC
LIMIT 1;

question: Find customer segments whose average payment per order exceeds 41.
query:
SELECT cs.name_customer_segments, AVG(p.amount) AS avg_order_value
FROM customer_segments cs
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_segment_id = cs.id
JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id
JOIN payments p ON p.order_id = o.id
GROUP BY cs.id, cs.name_customer_segments
HAVING AVG(p.amount) > 41
ORDER BY avg_order_value DESC;

Question: Find customer segments whose average payment per order exceeds 41.

SELECT cs.name_customer_segments, AVG(p.amount) AS avg_order_value
FROM customer_segments cs
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_segment_id = cs.id
JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id
JOIN payments p ON p.order_id = o.id
GROUP BY cs.id, cs.name_customer_segments
HAVING AVG(p.amount) > 41
ORDER BY avg_order_value DESC;

SELECT name_products, unit_price, unit_cost,
       ROUND(100.0 * (unit_price - unit_cost) / unit_price, 2) AS margin_pct
FROM products
WHERE unit_cost IS NOT NULL
  AND 100.0 * (unit_price - unit_cost) / unit_price < 21
ORDER BY margin_pct ASC;

question: Within the 'Retail' segment, who are the top 4 customers by total payment amount?

FROM customers c
JOIN customer_segments cs ON c.customer_segment_id = cs.id
JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id
JOIN payments p ON p.order_id = o.id
WHERE cs.name_customer_segments = 'Retail'
GROUP BY c.id, c.name_customers
ORDER BY total_spent DESC
LIMIT 4;

question: Which product categories generated more than 89500 in total order revenue?
query:
SELECT pc.name_product_categories, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) AS revenue
FROM product_categories pc
JOIN products p ON p.product_category_id = pc.id
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.product_id = p.id
GROUP BY pc.id, pc.name_product_categories
HAVING SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) > 89500
ORDER BY revenue DESC;

question: Which product categories generated more than 167500 in total order revenue?
query:
SELECT pc.name_product_categories, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) AS revenue
FROM product_categories pc
JOIN products p ON p.product_category_id = pc.id
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.product_id = p.id
GROUP BY pc.id, pc.name_product_categories
HAVING SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) > 167500
ORDER BY revenue DESC;

SELECT pc.name_product_categories, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) AS revenue
FROM product_categories pc
JOIN products p ON p.product_category_id = pc.id
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.product_id = p.id
GROUP BY pc.id, pc.name_product_categories
HAVING SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) > 99000
ORDER BY revenue DESC;

ORDER BY total_spent DESC

FROM customers c

JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id
JOIN payments p ON p.order_id = o.id

        JOIN payments p2 ON p2.order_id = o2.id
        WHERE cs2.name_customer_segments = 'Wholesale'
        GROUP BY c2.id
    )
)
ORDER BY total_spent DESC;

question: Find product categories whose total order revenue exceeds 114500.
query:
SELECT pc.name_product_categories, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) AS revenue
FROM product_categories pc
JOIN products p ON p.product_category_id = pc.id
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.product_id = p.id
GROUP BY pc.id, pc.name_product_categories
HAVING SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) > 114500
ORDER BY revenue DESC;

question: List the 3 highest-spending customers with their region and customer segment.
query:
SELECT c.name_customers, r.name_regions, cs.name_customer_segments,
       SUM(p.amount) AS total_spent
FROM customers c
JOIN regions r ON c.region_id = r.id
JOIN customer_segments cs ON c.customer_segment_id = cs.id
JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id
JOIN payments p ON p.order_id = o.id
GROUP BY c.id, c.name_customers, r.name_regions, cs.name_customer_segments
ORDER BY total_spent DESC
LIMIT 3;

question: Which products had a discount applied in more than 42 percent of their order line items?
query:
SELECT p.name_products,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN oi.discount > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS discounted_pct
FROM order_items oi
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id
GROUP BY p.id, p.name_products
HAVING 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN oi.discount > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) > 42
ORDER BY discounted_pct DESC;

question: Find customer segments whose average payment per order exceeds 322.

FROM customer_segments cs
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_segment_id = cs.id
JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id
JOIN payments p ON p.order_id = o.id
GROUP BY cs.id, cs.name_customer_segments
HAVING AVG(p.amount) > 322
ORDER BY avg_order_value DESC;

JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id
JOIN payments p ON p.order_id = o.id
WHERE cs.name_customer_segments = 'Wholesale'
GROUP BY c.id, c.name_customers
ORDER BY total_spent DESC
LIMIT 13;

question: What was the total revenue from the 'Software' category in 2023?

SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) AS revenue
FROM order_items oi
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id
JOIN product_categories pc ON p.product_category_id = pc.id
JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.id
WHERE pc.name_product_categories = 'Software'
  AND o.order_date >= '2023-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2024-01-01';

question: Find products discounted on more than 34% of their order items.
query:
SELECT p.name_products,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN oi.discount > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS discounted_pct
FROM order_items oi
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id
GROUP BY p.id, p.name_products
HAVING 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN oi.discount > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) > 34
ORDER BY discounted_pct DESC;

question: Find products discounted on more than 44% of their order items.
query:
SELECT p.name_products,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN oi.discount > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS discounted_pct
FROM order_items oi
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id
GROUP BY p.id, p.name_products
HAVING 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN oi.discount > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) > 44
ORDER BY discounted_pct DESC;

GROUP BY month
ORDER BY month;

question: Which products have a profit margin (unit price minus unit cost, as a percentage of unit price) below 20 percent?
query:
SELECT name_products, unit_price, unit_cost,
       ROUND(100.0 * (unit_price - unit_cost) / unit_price, 2) AS margin_pct
FROM products
WHERE unit_cost IS NOT NULL
  AND 100.0 * (unit_price - unit_cost) / unit_price < 20
ORDER BY margin_pct ASC;

question: How much revenue did 'Hardware' products generate during 2021?
query:
SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) AS revenue
FROM order_items oi
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id
JOIN product_categories pc ON p.product_category_id = pc.id
JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.id
WHERE pc.name_product_categories = 'Hardware'
  AND o.order_date >= '2021-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2022-01-01';

question: Find product categories whose total order revenue exceeds 178000.
query:
SELECT pc.name_product_categories, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) AS revenue
FROM product_categories pc
JOIN products p ON p.product_category_id = pc.id
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.product_id = p.id
GROUP BY pc.id, pc.name_product_categories
HAVING SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) > 178000
ORDER BY revenue DESC;

question: For the 'Hardware' category, which region generated the most revenue, and how much?
query:
SELECT r.name_regions, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) AS revenue
FROM order_items oi
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id
JOIN product_categories pc ON p.product_category_id = pc.id
JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.id
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.id
JOIN regions r ON c.region_id = r.id
WHERE pc.name_product_categories = 'Hardware'
GROUP BY r.id, r.name_regions
ORDER BY revenue DESC
LIMIT 1;

question: Find sales employees with more than 5 orders in 2016, along with the total payments they generated.
query:
SELECT e.name_employees, COUNT(o.id) AS order_count, SUM(p.amount) AS total_payment_volume
FROM employees e
JOIN orders o ON o.employee_id = e.id
LEFT JOIN payments p ON p.order_id = o.id
WHERE e.role_employees = 'sales'
  AND o.order_date >= '2016-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2017-01-01'
GROUP BY e.id, e.name_employees
HAVING COUNT(o.id) > 5
ORDER BY total_payment_volume DESC;

question: Which customer segments have an average order payment value above 341?

SELECT cs.name_customer_segments, AVG(p.amount) AS avg_order_value
FROM customer_segments cs
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_segment_id = cs.id
JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id
JOIN payments p ON p.order_id = o.id
GROUP BY cs.id, cs.name_customer_segments
HAVING AVG(p.amount) > 341
ORDER BY avg_order_value DESC;

question: Find products discounted on more than 50% of their order items.
query:
SELECT p.name_products,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN oi.discount > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS discounted_pct
FROM order_items oi
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id
GROUP BY p.id, p.name_products
HAVING 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN oi.discount > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) > 50
ORDER BY discounted_pct DESC;

SELECT pc.name_product_categories, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) AS revenue
FROM product_categories pc
JOIN products p ON p.product_category_id = pc.id
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.product_id = p.id
GROUP BY pc.id, pc.name_product_categories
HAVING SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) > 175500
ORDER BY revenue DESC;

question: Find employees whose order count beats the average for their own region.
query:
SELECT e.name_employees, r.name_regions, COUNT(o.id) AS order_count
FROM employees e
JOIN regions r ON e.region_id = r.id
JOIN orders o ON o.employee_id = e.id
GROUP BY e.id, e.name_employees, r.name_regions
HAVING COUNT(o.id) > (
    SELECT AVG(cnt) FROM (
        SELECT e2.id, COUNT(o2.id) AS cnt
        FROM employees e2
        JOIN orders o2 ON o2.employee_id = e2.id
        WHERE e2.region_id = e.region_id
        GROUP BY e2.id
    )
)
ORDER BY order_count DESC;

JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id

GROUP BY cs.id, cs.name_customer_segments

ORDER BY avg_order_value DESC;

ORDER BY avg_order_value DESC;

FROM product_categories pc

GROUP BY pc.id, pc.name_product_categories
HAVING SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) > 83000
ORDER BY revenue DESC;

question: Within the 'Enterprise' segment, who are the top 15 customers by total payment amount?
query:
SELECT c.name_customers, SUM(p.amount) AS total_spent
FROM customers c
JOIN customer_segments cs ON c.customer_segment_id = cs.id
JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id
JOIN payments p ON p.order_id = o.id
WHERE cs.name_customer_segments = 'Enterprise'
GROUP BY c.id, c.name_customers
ORDER BY total_spent DESC
LIMIT 15;

question: List the 17 highest-spending customers with their region and customer segment.
query:
SELECT c.name_customers, r.name_regions, cs.name_customer_segments,
       SUM(p.amount) AS total_spent
FROM customers c
JOIN regions r ON c.region_id = r.id
JOIN customer_segments cs ON c.customer_segment_id = cs.id
JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id
JOIN payments p ON p.order_id = o.id
GROUP BY c.id, c.name_customers, r.name_regions, cs.name_customer_segments
ORDER BY total_spent DESC
LIMIT 17;

question: Which product categories generated more than 138500 in total order revenue?
query:
SELECT pc.name_product_categories, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) AS revenue
FROM product_categories pc
JOIN products p ON p.product_category_id = pc.id
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.product_id = p.id
GROUP BY pc.id, pc.name_product_categories
HAVING SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) > 138500
ORDER BY revenue DESC;

question: Find sales employees with more than 9 orders in 2022, along with the total payments they generated.
query:
SELECT e.name_employees, COUNT(o.id) AS order_count, SUM(p.amount) AS total_payment_volume
FROM employees e
JOIN orders o ON o.employee_id = e.id
LEFT JOIN payments p ON p.order_id = o.id
WHERE e.role_employees = 'sales'
  AND o.order_date >= '2022-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2023-01-01'
GROUP BY e.id, e.name_employees
HAVING COUNT(o.id) > 9
ORDER BY total_payment_volume DESC;

question: Who are the top 6 customers by total payment amount, including their region and segment?
query:
SELECT c.name_customers, r.name_regions, cs.name_customer_segments,
       SUM(p.amount) AS total_spent
FROM customers c
JOIN regions r ON c.region_id = r.id
JOIN customer_segments cs ON c.customer_segment_id = cs.id
JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id
JOIN payments p ON p.order_id = o.id
GROUP BY c.id, c.name_customers, r.name_regions, cs.name_customer_segments
ORDER BY total_spent DESC
LIMIT 6;

question: Which customer segments have an average order payment value above 227?
query:
SELECT cs.name_customer_segments, AVG(p.amount) AS avg_order_value
FROM customer_segments cs
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_segment_id = cs.id
JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id
JOIN payments p ON p.order_id = o.id
GROUP BY cs.id, cs.name_customer_segments

question: Which sales employees handled more than 11 orders in 2022, and what was the total payment volume they managed?
query:
SELECT e.name_employees, COUNT(o.id) AS order_count, SUM(p.amount) AS total_payment_volume
FROM employees e
JOIN orders o ON o.employee_id = e.id
LEFT JOIN payments p ON p.order_id = o.id
WHERE e.role_employees = 'sales'
  AND o.order_date >= '2022-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2023-01-01'
GROUP BY e.id, e.name_employees
HAVING COUNT(o.id) > 11
ORDER BY total_payment_volume DESC;

question: List the 15 highest-spending customers with their region and customer segment.
query:
SELECT c.name_customers, r.name_regions, cs.name_customer_segments,
       SUM(p.amount) AS total_spent
FROM customers c
JOIN regions r ON c.region_id = r.id
JOIN customer_segments cs ON c.customer_segment_id = cs.id
JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id
JOIN payments p ON p.order_id = o.id
GROUP BY c.id, c.name_customers, r.name_regions, cs.name_customer_segments
ORDER BY total_spent DESC
LIMIT 15;

question: Find product categories whose total order revenue exceeds 143000.
query:
SELECT pc.name_product_categories, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) AS revenue
FROM product_categories pc
JOIN products p ON p.product_category_id = pc.id
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.product_id = p.id
GROUP BY pc.id, pc.name_product_categories
HAVING SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) > 143000
ORDER BY revenue DESC;

question: Find customer segments whose average payment per order exceeds 241.
query:
SELECT cs.name_customer_segments, AVG(p.amount) AS avg_order_value
FROM customer_segments cs
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_segment_id = cs.id
JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id
JOIN payments p ON p.order_id = o.id
GROUP BY cs.id, cs.name_customer_segments
HAVING AVG(p.amount) > 241
ORDER BY avg_order_value DESC;

question: How much revenue did 'Laptops' products generate during 2023?
query:
SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) AS revenue
FROM order_items oi
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id
JOIN product_categories pc ON p.product_category_id = pc.id
JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.id
WHERE pc.name_product_categories = 'Laptops'
  AND o.order_date >= '2023-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2024-01-01';

question: Find customer segments whose average payment per order exceeds 411.
query:
SELECT cs.name_customer_segments, AVG(p.amount) AS avg_order_value
FROM customer_segments cs
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_segment_id = cs.id
JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id
JOIN payments p ON p.order_id = o.id
GROUP BY cs.id, cs.name_customer_segments
HAVING AVG(p.amount) > 411
ORDER BY avg_order_value DESC;

question: Which product categories generated more than 166500 in total order revenue?
query:
SELECT pc.name_product_categories, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) AS revenue
FROM product_categories pc
JOIN products p ON p.product_category_id = pc.id
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.product_id = p.id
GROUP BY pc.id, pc.name_product_categories
HAVING SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) > 166500
ORDER BY revenue DESC;

JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id
JOIN payments p ON p.order_id = o.id
WHERE cs.name_customer_segments = 'Wholesale'
GROUP BY c.id, c.name_customers
ORDER BY total_spent DESC
LIMIT 10;

question: Find products with a margin under 37% of their unit price.
query:
SELECT name_products, unit_price, unit_cost,
       ROUND(100.0 * (unit_price - unit_cost) / unit_price, 2) AS margin_pct
FROM products
WHERE unit_cost IS NOT NULL
  AND 100.0 * (unit_price - unit_cost) / unit_price < 37
ORDER BY margin_pct ASC;

question: Find product categories whose total order revenue exceeds 22000.
query:
SELECT pc.name_product_categories, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) AS revenue
FROM product_categories pc
JOIN products p ON p.product_category_id = pc.id
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.product_id = p.id
GROUP BY pc.id, pc.name_product_categories
HAVING SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) > 22000
ORDER BY revenue DESC;

JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id
JOIN payments p ON p.order_id = o.id
GROUP BY cs.id, cs.name_customer_segments
HAVING AVG(p.amount) > 471
ORDER BY avg_order_value DESC;

question: Which product categories generated more than 12500 in total order revenue?
query:
SELECT pc.name_product_categories, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) AS revenue
FROM product_categories pc
JOIN products p ON p.product_category_id = pc.id
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.product_id = p.id
GROUP BY pc.id, pc.name_product_categories
HAVING SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) > 12500
ORDER BY revenue DESC;

question: Within the 'Wholesale' segment, who are the top 14 customers by total payment amount?
query:
SELECT c.name_customers, SUM(p.amount) AS total_spent
FROM customers c
JOIN customer_segments cs ON c.customer_segment_id = cs.id
JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id
JOIN payments p ON p.order_id = o.id
WHERE cs.name_customer_segments = 'Wholesale'
GROUP BY c.id, c.name_customers
ORDER BY total_spent DESC
LIMIT 14;

question: Within the 'Enterprise' segment, which customers spent more than the segment's average total payment?
query:
SELECT c.name_customers, SUM(p.amount) AS total_spent
FROM customers c
JOIN customer_segments cs ON c.customer_segment_id = cs.id
JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id
JOIN payments p ON p.order_id = o.id
WHERE cs.name_customer_segments = 'Enterprise'
GROUP BY c.id, c.name_customers
HAVING SUM(p.amount) > (
    SELECT AVG(seg_total) FROM (
        SELECT SUM(p2.amount) AS seg_total
        FROM customers c2
        JOIN customer_segments cs2 ON c2.customer_segment_id = cs2.id
        JOIN orders o2 ON o2.customer_id = c2.id
        JOIN payments p2 ON p2.order_id = o2.id
        WHERE cs2.name_customer_segments = 'Enterprise'
        GROUP BY c2.id
    )
)
ORDER BY total_spent DESC;

question: Which product categories generated more than 132000 in total order revenue?
query:
SELECT pc.name_product_categories, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) AS revenue
FROM product_categories pc
JOIN products p ON p.product_category_id = pc.id
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.product_id = p.id
GROUP BY pc.id, pc.name_product_categories
HAVING SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) > 132000
ORDER BY revenue DESC;

question: Which products had a discount applied in more than 27 percent of their order line items?
query:
SELECT p.name_products,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN oi.discount > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS discounted_pct
FROM order_items oi
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id
GROUP BY p.id, p.name_products
HAVING 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN oi.discount > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) > 27
ORDER BY discounted_pct DESC;

Question: Which products had a discount applied in more than 27 percent of their order line items?

SELECT p.name_products,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN oi.discount > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS discounted_pct

question: Find sales employees with more than 10 orders in 2017, along with the total payments they generated.
query:
SELECT e.name_employees, COUNT(o.id) AS order_count, SUM(p.amount) AS total_payment_volume
FROM employees e
JOIN orders o ON o.employee_id = e.id
LEFT JOIN payments p ON p.order_id = o.id
WHERE e.role_employees = 'sales'
  AND o.order_date >= '2017-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2018-01-01'
GROUP BY e.id, e.name_employees
HAVING COUNT(o.id) > 10
ORDER BY total_payment_volume DESC;

question: List the 5 biggest spenders in the 'Wholesale' customer segment.
query:
SELECT c.name_customers, SUM(p.amount) AS total_spent
FROM customers c
JOIN customer_segments cs ON c.customer_segment_id = cs.id
JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id
JOIN payments p ON p.order_id = o.id
WHERE cs.name_customer_segments = 'Wholesale'
GROUP BY c.id, c.name_customers
ORDER BY total_spent DESC
LIMIT 5;

question: Find products discounted on more than 28% of their order items.
query:
SELECT p.name_products,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN oi.discount > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS discounted_pct
FROM order_items oi
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id
GROUP BY p.id, p.name_products
HAVING 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN oi.discount > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) > 28
ORDER BY discounted_pct DESC;

question: Find product categories whose total order revenue exceeds 50000.
query:
SELECT pc.name_product_categories, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) AS revenue
FROM product_categories pc
JOIN products p ON p.product_category_id = pc.id
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.product_id = p.id
GROUP BY pc.id, pc.name_product_categories
HAVING SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) > 50000
ORDER BY revenue DESC;

question: Who are the top 16 customers by total payment amount, including their region and segment?
query:
SELECT c.name_customers, r.name_regions, cs.name_customer_segments,
       SUM(p.amount) AS total_spent
FROM customers c
JOIN regions r ON c.region_id = r.id
JOIN customer_segments cs ON c.customer_segment_id = cs.id
JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id
JOIN payments p ON p.order_id = o.id
GROUP BY c.id, c.name_customers, r.name_regions, cs.name_customer_segments
ORDER BY total_spent DESC
LIMIT 16;

question: Which sales employees handled more than 9 orders in 2022, and what was the total payment volume they managed?
query:
SELECT e.name_employees, COUNT(o.id) AS order_count, SUM(p.amount) AS total_payment_volume
FROM employees e
JOIN orders o ON o.employee_id = e.id
LEFT JOIN payments p ON p.order_id = o.id
WHERE e.role_employees = 'sales'
  AND o.order_date >= '2022-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2023-01-01'
GROUP BY e.id, e.name_employees
HAVING COUNT(o.id) > 9
ORDER BY total_payment_volume DESC;

question: Find product categories whose total order revenue exceeds 185000.
query:
SELECT pc.name_product_categories, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) AS revenue
FROM product_categories pc
JOIN products p ON p.product_category_id = pc.id
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.product_id = p.id
GROUP BY pc.id, pc.name_product_categories
HAVING SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) > 185000
ORDER BY revenue DESC;

question: Find customer segments whose average payment per order exceeds 290.
query:
SELECT cs.name_customer_segments, AVG(p.amount) AS avg_order_value
FROM customer_segments cs
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_segment_id = cs.id
JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id
JOIN payments p ON p.order_id = o.id
GROUP BY cs.id, cs.name_customer_segments
HAVING AVG(p.amount) > 290
ORDER BY avg_order_value DESC;

question: Find sales employees with more than 9 orders in 2023, along with the total payments they generated.
query:
SELECT e.name_employees, COUNT(o.id) AS order_count, SUM(p.amount) AS total_payment_volume
FROM employees e
JOIN orders o ON o.employee_id = e.id
LEFT JOIN payments p ON p.order_id = o.id
WHERE e.role_employees = 'sales'
  AND o.order_date >= '2023-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2024-01-01'
GROUP BY e.id, e.name_employees
HAVING COUNT(o.id) > 9
ORDER BY total_payment_volume DESC;

question: Which product categories generated more than 69000 in total order revenue?
query:
SELECT pc.name_product_categories, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) AS revenue
FROM product_categories pc
JOIN products p ON p.product_category_id = pc.id
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.product_id = p.id
GROUP BY pc.id, pc.name_product_categories
HAVING SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) > 69000
ORDER BY revenue DESC;

GROUP BY cs.id, cs.name_customer_segments
ORDER BY customer_count DESC;

question: Find customer segments whose average payment per order exceeds 490.
query:
SELECT cs.name_customer_segments, AVG(p.amount) AS avg_order_value
FROM customer_segments cs
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_segment_id = cs.id
JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id
JOIN payments p ON p.order_id = o.id
GROUP BY cs.id, cs.name_customer_segments
HAVING AVG(p.amount) > 490
ORDER BY avg_order_value DESC;

Question: Find customer segments whose average payment per order exceeds 38.

SELECT cs.name_customer_segments, AVG(p.amount) AS avg_order_value
FROM customer_segments cs
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_segment_id = cs.id
JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id
JOIN payments p ON p.order_id = o.id
GROUP BY cs.id, cs.name_customer_segments
HAVING AVG(p.amount) > 38
ORDER BY avg_order_value DESC;
